title: Real vs pseudo-words (Y1 check)
examples: Teacher, how do I know if a word is real?
Can we practice sounding out some tricky words?
Should I just guess the meaning of a word?

explain.say: Today we will learn about real words and fake words. We will sound out the letters to read them.
A real word is a word that people actually say and write. It has a meaning you know.
A fake word is a word that we make up just for fun. It sounds right but has no real meaning.
We must use every sound we hear when we read any word. We cannot guess the meaning at all.
Let us try one. If I say 'gloop', we sound it out: g-l-o-o-p. It is a fake word.

faq.q: How do I know if a word is real?
faq.a: If you have heard it before or if it is in a book, it is probably a real word. You can try to sound it out to check.
asks: Can you check if a word is real?
What is the difference between real and fake words?

faq.q: Do I have to use every sound when I read a word?
faq.a: Yes, you must sound out every single letter sound. Do not try to remember what it means first.
asks: Can I guess the word if I know the topic?
Should I skip sounds if I know the word?

faq.a: A pseudo-word is just a made-up word. It follows the rules of sounds but does not exist in English.

faq.q: If I sound out a word, how do I know if it is right?
faq.a: If it sounds like a word you know, it might be real. If it sounds like nonsense, it is probably fake.
asks: Is sounding out enough to know?
How can I check if my sounding is correct?

faq.q: Can I use pictures to help me read a word?
faq.a: It is best to sound out the word using the letters, not the picture. The picture can trick your sounding.
asks: Can I look at the picture first?
Is looking at the picture okay?

facts: Real words are words that people use in speaking and writing.
Fake words are made up words that do not have any real meaning.
When reading, you must sound out every single letter sound.
Blending all the sounds together helps you read correctly.

quiz.say: Sound it out: b-l-a-t. Is it a real word?
quiz.why: You must sound out every letter sound to check if it is real.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it sounds like a word you know.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you know what the letters look like.
wrong.2: This is tempting because you know the meaning of the letters.

quiz.say: Sound it out: cat. Is it a real word?

options.show: It means a type of cat.
options.say: It means a type of cat.

quiz.why: You sounded out the letters and it is a word we use every day.

wrong.0: This is tempting because you know what the word means.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you are thinking of made-up words.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it is an easy word to remember.

quiz.say: Sound it out: zorp. Is it a real word?
quiz.why: You used every sound, and since no one uses this word, it is fake.

wrong.1: This is tempting because you are trying to find a meaning.
wrong.2: This is tempting because it has clear consonant sounds.
wrong.3: This is tempting because guessing is easier than sounding.
